label: copy-phase input z (fed-back z), early-middle of copy, not last step
explanation: Fires almost exclusively (99.8% of mass) when the input token is z during the copy phase, i.e. the model has just echoed an original z back as input. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, and essentially never on other tokens (in_tok z lift 32x). Within copy-phase z inputs it is position-gated: activity concentrates at recall_idx 3-4 (z was original token 2 or 3; ~89% of mass), weaker at recall_idx 5, and nearly silent at recall_idx <= 2. It is suppressed on the final copy step (to_go = 0) and in short sequences (L <= 5), so many copy-phase z inputs stay silent (precision of the bare z-in-copy rule is only 0.28). Strongest activations: z at original position 2 in long sequences (L 8-9), with a second consecutive z firing more weakly. Small residual activity at late recall_idx 7-8 in L = 9 sequences is not captured. Dev: P 0.79, R 0.76, F1 0.77, mass recall 0.88.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: z, o, h, e, 3, f; least: x, p, d, a) and the next token to output (most: v, l, 2, k, i, d; least: z, 0, -, f); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, recall_idx=4, L=9 & t=12.
